judgment.status_reasoning: AITI's press release of 11 April 2025 announces the guide; the guide says it may be amended periodically. AITI's AI governance page lists a 'Second Edition' next to the guide without a date, so the guide may have been replaced. date_last_updated stays null because the Second Edition's date is not in a stored text.
judgment.scope_reasoning: Government AI governance and ethics guide; in scope without a note.

open_questions: AITI's AI governance page lists 'Guide on AI Governance and Ethics for Brunei Darussalam (Second Edition)', which is stored only as a link; its text, date and relation to this guide are unknown, and the status may be Superseded.
The guide PDF is in English; the record's language 'English, Malay' and original_title rest on AITI's bilingual press release, not on the guide itself.
